حَسْبِيَ is the predicate expression with ٱللَّهُ as its nominal subject.
إِلَٰهَ is the governed noun of categorical negation لَآ.
هُوَ is the excepted pronoun after إِلَّا in لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ.
The هِ suffix in عَلَيْهِ is governed by عَلَى as the fronted complement of تَوَكَّلْتُ.
رَبُّ is the predicate of هُوَ in the final nominal clause.
ٱلْعَرْشِ is the genitive complement of رَبُّ.
ٱلْعَظِيمِ agrees with ٱلْعَرْشِ as its genitive definite adjective.
